hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; AHEAD=$(git log origin/master..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$AHEAD" -gt 0 ]; then jq -n --arg n "$AHEAD" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("UNPUSHED COMMITS: " + $n + " commit(s) ahead of origin/master. Run /deploy when ready to go live.")}}'; fi
